## VantaVault v0.5.27

### Added
- A persistent notification center for wishlist matches, Riot messages, and application errors.
- Configurable interface sounds and volume, including match-found, success, message, and error cues.
- Keyboard shortcuts for navigation, Settings, reload, and full app restart.
- Viper, Harbor, and Gekko wallpapers plus direct GitHub and Discord community links.
- Richer live-player loadout details and Discord presence with map, agent, score, party, and agent-select timing context.

### Improved
- Redesigned Settings, loading, storefront, party, live-match, and Profile experiences across dark, light, and custom-background themes.
- Profile analytics and the competitive archive now present current-act RR, placements, recent maps, agents, party performance, and historical acts more clearly.
- Live-match and party views show clearer teams, scores, queue timing, ranks, private identities, and equipped weapon cosmetics.
- Match storage now retains playtime, ability usage, assistants, plant and defuse locations, round economy, player impact, and RR performance bonuses.
- Remote Riot accounts use the local client only as a same-account fallback, avoiding accidental data from a different local login.

### Fixed
- Previous-act ranks, casual-match tiers, and old RR deltas no longer appear as the current competitive act.
- Placement wins and losses can be corrected from cached competitive match evidence without losing Riot's authoritative RR state.
- Party queue timers clear outside matchmaking and accept Riot's supported timestamp formats.
- Live loadout cosmetics remain attached to their own weapons instead of being mixed across the inventory.
- Remote outgoing friend requests can be cancelled reliably, including already-completed and refreshed-roster cases.
- Improved handling for incomplete Riot names, ranks, social sessions, match analytics, and daily-ticket renewal.
- Updated the inherited Sharp/libvips image dependency to the patched release required by the production security audit.
- The portable launcher now links its Visual C++ runtime statically, so it starts on clean Windows systems without a separately installed redistributable.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe` — run directly with no setup. It can download and switch to later portable releases from Settings.
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.27_x64-setup.exe` — optional per-user installation. No administrator rights are required.

### Auto-update
Both release types update from inside VantaVault. Portable updates download a signed replacement, verify its SHA-256 digest, and restart without opening setup.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.26...v0.5.27
